## Subjective

35yo M, no PMH, presents with 12 days of nasal congestion + facial pressure (location: maxillary sinuses; quality: pressure-like, throbbing; severity: 6/10; duration: 12 days; timing: worse on bending forward; modifying factors: improves with decongestants partially). Initial cold-like sx for 5 days, partial improvement, then worsening with thick yellow-green nasal d/c × 4 days, low-grade fever 100.4 today. Denies tooth pain, no eye sx.

## Objective

VS: BP 124/78, HR 84, T 100.4°F. Gen: NAD. HEENT: erythematous nasal mucosa, purulent yellow d/c visible, mild tenderness over bilateral maxillary sinuses on palpation; oropharynx clear. Lungs: CTAB.

## Assessment

1. Acute bacterial sinusitis (J01.90)

## Plan

Started amoxicillin 500mg PO TID × 7 days. OTC saline rinses + decongestants, oral hydration. Patient counseled on completing full antibiotic course, return for worsening fever, severe headache, vision changes, or no improvement after 72 hr. F/u PRN.
